claims.evidence: Witness only reports a wooden kids play/learning cabinet/toy storage unit with stickers; no clear condition indicators (scratches, cracks, warping) are described.
Witness notes it has two door sections, but does not confirm what 'two step' means (e.g., steps vs door design).
Witness describes a blue oval window-like panel and stickers, but does not mention a mirror.
Witness does not mention wheels/tyres or base design.

risks.risk: Wrong item type/feature mismatch (wardrobe vs toy cabinet; mirror and wheels may not exist).
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the full front (including any mirror) and the bottom/base (showing wheels/tyres if present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a basic kids wooden toy/play cabinet without confirmed mirror or wheels.

risks.risk: Hidden damage/poor condition (scratches, cracks, warping, loose hinges/handles) not visible in the witness description.
risks.proof: Close-up clips of hinges/handles and corners/edges from multiple angles, plus a quick open/close door video.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for used condition (possible wear and minor defects).

risks.risk: Safety/stability issues for a child item (sharp edges, paint quality, wobble/anti-tip).
risks.proof: A clip showing the unit placed on the floor with a gentle push test (no wobble), and close-ups of edge finishing and paint surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not safety-verified (assume potential minor safety concerns).

risks.risk: Material/quality uncertainty (solid wood vs MDF/plywood; thickness).
risks.proof: Photo of side thickness/edge grain and a close-up of construction joints; if possible, a photo of the back panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lower-grade board construction rather than premium solid wood.

risks.risk: Size/fit risk (dimensions not provided; may not fit the buyer’s space).
risks.proof: A tape-measure photo showing height, width, and depth.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic small cabinet with unknown dimensions (worst-case for buyer fit).

proof_requests: Full clear photos of the entire unit front and sides, including any mirror area (if present).
Bottom/base photo showing whether there are wheels/tyres.
Close-up photos of hinges/handles and corners/edges for damage and sharpness.
Short video opening and closing both doors to confirm smooth operation and any locks/fasteners.
Photos showing material quality (edge grain/thickness) and construction joints.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a kids wooden play/toy cabinet with two doors and decorative panels, so it can be priced at a worst-case used level; unverified features (mirror, wheels, exact wardrobe function) are handled by pricing without them.
